order: Once round 2 reaches approval, finish the round with a residual cleanup pass — close out anything left over in the review lint script and bring the status file and band record in line with the approved state. Update the lint script's checks so they reflect the ruleset the round actually settled on, never an intermediate draft still lingering in the file. Rewrite the band record's round ledger so every round's disposition and the final tally are stated exactly — no round left off, no tally approximated, and no earlier round's disposition quietly revised along the way. Keep the status file's phase summary consistent with the ledger's own numbers, matching them count for count. Leave every file outside these three alone, and add no new lint check beyond tidying the ones already in place; this is only a closing pass, not a new review round.
claims: We closed out the round with a residual cleanup — the lint script picked up 15 lines of check adjustments, the band record's round ledger was rewritten (53 lines touched) to state each round's disposition exactly, and the status file was brought into line, for 50 insertions and 31 deletions across exactly three files. The status file's phase summary was checked number-by-number against the rewritten ledger, with every shared count matching exactly.
